reference_sql:
SELECT product_id, product_name, brand, unit_cost_eur
FROM products
WHERE brand IN ('Sonora', 'Basswell')
  AND (unit_cost_eur < 100 OR unit_cost_eur > 500)
alternatives:
SELECT product_id, product_name, brand, unit_cost_eur
FROM products
WHERE (unit_cost_eur < 100 OR unit_cost_eur > 500)
  AND brand IN ('Basswell', 'Sonora')

SELECT product_id, product_name, brand, unit_cost_eur
FROM products
WHERE brand IN ('Sonora', 'Basswell')
  AND NOT unit_cost_eur BETWEEN 100 AND 500

other_way.sql:
SELECT product_id, product_name, brand, unit_cost_eur
FROM products
WHERE brand IN ('Sonora', 'Basswell')
  AND NOT unit_cost_eur BETWEEN 100 AND 500
other_way.tradeoff: NOT BETWEEN is shorter, but the two-sided OR makes the edges easier to see.
